description: Resets the current HEAD to a specified state. Supports soft, mixed, hard, merge, and keep modes. The 'hard' mode requires confirm=true as a safety guard since it permanently discards changes. Returns structured data with the ref, mode, and list of affected files. Pass `path` to target a specific repo or worktree — when omitted, operates on the server's own working directory, not the caller's (see #876).

confirm.description: Safety confirmation required when mode is 'hard'. Must be set to true to proceed with --hard reset, which permanently discards uncommitted changes.

files.description: File paths to unstage (omit to unstage all)

intentToAdd.description: Keep paths in index as intent-to-add (-N)

mode.description: Reset mode: soft (keep staged), mixed (default, unstage), hard (discard all), merge, keep

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

name: reset
title: Git Reset
